newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemex raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemex raised to buy.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns said on Tuesday it had raised its rating on Cemex S.A. to buy from neutral at a price of $7.50 per American Depositary Share.

-- In an analysis, it said Cemex's market share loss in Mexico reversed itself in the third quarter, strength in the United States is expected to continue through 1997, Venezuela operations are ready to recover, and management is more cautious about acquisitions.
-- "We are raising our 12-month target price from $9 to $10.25," analysts Sobani Warner and Daniel Altman wrote.
